newsitem.title: CANADA: Westcoast Jedney gas plant starts operation.
newsitem.headline: Westcoast Jedney gas plant starts operation.

text.p: Westcoast Energy Inc said Tuesday its Jedney natural gas plant in northeastern British Columbia has been completed on budget at C$48 million and is now operating.

It is operating at 35 to 40 million cubic feet a day and will increase to 70 million cubic feet a day over the next few months. The facility includes the 70 million cubic feet a day sour gas processing plant and 26-km pipeline.
The company hopes to double the plant's capacity by May and expects to receive government approval for the expansion early next year.
